# aft.page

Lang: en

> aft.page is a cloud for small software. It turns software an AI agent builds into a live, shareable HTTPS URL in seconds — no repository, cloud account, or build setup.

aft.page (also referred to as aft or AFT) hosts personal and small-team software created by AI agents. Deploy by Drop, paste, or MCP; then claim, share, and update the same durable `*.aft.page` URL. The name comes from the aft of a ship (the back of the vessel).

Specification: [AI Visibility](https://www.ai-visibility.org.uk/)

## Services

- [Drop deploy](https://aft.page/drop/): Upload a folder or zip of static files and get a live `*.aft.page` URL instantly, no account required
- [Agent MCP deploy](https://aft.page/mcp): Remote MCP at `https://mcp.aft.page/mcp` with `deploy`, `aft_deploys`, `aft_rollback`, and `aft_health`
- [Agent Plugin](https://aft.page/plugins): Coming soon — one install (`npx plugins add …`) for Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Copilot, VS Code, Grok, and Kimi
- [API deploy](https://api.aft.page): `POST /v1/deploy` and redeploy with an edit token for agents and scripts
- [Claim and share](https://aft.page/preview): Attach an anonymous deploy to an account, make it private, or invite people by email
- [Custom domains](https://aft.page/docs#domain): After claim, request access, CNAME to `cname.aft.page` (invite-only during beta)
- [Hosted small software](https://aft.page/): Serve agent-built HTML, static SPAs, and small apps at a durable HTTPS URL

## What We Do Not Do

aft.page does not provide:
- A website builder or drag-and-drop page designer
- A chat product or background coding-agent runner
- General-purpose Big Software cloud accounts, repos, or CI setup
- Guaranteed enterprise SLAs during free beta
- Ownership of user content published on `*.aft.page` (that content belongs to the deployer)

## Endpoints for agents

- Remote MCP: https://mcp.aft.page/mcp
- Health: https://api.aft.page/health
- Deploy: POST https://api.aft.page/v1/deploy
- Redeploy: PATCH https://api.aft.page/v1/deploy?slug={slug} (header X-Aft-Edit-Token)
- Claim: POST https://api.aft.page/v1/claim/start · GET /v1/claim/verify
- Site info: GET https://api.aft.page/v1/sites/{slug}
- Serve: https://{slug}.aft.page/

## MCP tools

Thin deploy adapter only (not a control plane):

- deploy — html or files → live URL (edit_token → same slug)
- aft_deploys — list rollback history (editToken)
- aft_rollback — restore a prior deployId (same URL)
- aft_health — ping the API

```json
{ "mcpServers": { "aft-page": { "url": "https://mcp.aft.page/mcp" } } }
```

## Limits

200 files · 10 MB / file · 50 MB total · anonymous deploy · editToken on each deploy · claim at /claim · custom domains after claim (request access) · free during beta

## AI Discovery Files

- [llms.txt](https://aft.page/llms.txt): This file (canonical machine-readable identity)
- [llms.html](https://aft.page/llms.html): Human-readable twin
- [ai.txt](https://aft.page/ai.txt): AI usage permissions
- [ai.json](https://aft.page/ai.json): Machine-parseable AI permissions
- [identity.json](https://aft.page/identity.json): Structured identity
- [brand.txt](https://aft.page/brand.txt): Naming and brand voice
- [faq-ai.txt](https://aft.page/faq-ai.txt): FAQ for AI systems
- [developer-ai.txt](https://aft.page/developer-ai.txt): Technical context for agents
- [robots-ai.txt](https://aft.page/robots-ai.txt): AI crawler directives
